verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete. The server feature forwards `dp-planner` to `sparq-engine` and adds it to the server binary's default set without changing the engine library default or adding dependencies. The integration test exercises a real three-pattern connected BGP, compares the compiled-in default planner path with the explicitly disabled greedy path, checks nonempty expected answers, and verifies scoped opt-out restoration. Its compile-time reference also detects broken feature forwarding. The comments accurately disclose the limitation that removing the server feature from `default` would compile the gated test to zero tests, so the test does not overclaim that half of the tripwire. README and HTTP-server skill documentation match the Cargo feature behavior and preserve the documented no-default-features opt-out. No hostile instructions were detected in the diff.
